mxCell.value: reconciliation_runs ---------------------- id (PK, serial) run_id (varchar, unique) tenant_id (varchar) run_type (varchar: daily/weekly/on_demand) period_start / period_end (timestamp) status (varchar: running/completed/failed) total_tb_transactions (int) total_pg_transactions (int) matched_count (int) discrepancy_count (int) started_at / completed_at (timestamp) error_message (text, nullable) created_at

reconciliation_discrepancies ---------------------- id (PK, serial) run_id (FK -> reconciliation_runs) discrepancy_type (varchar: missing_in_pg/missing_in_tb/amount_mismatch) transaction_id (varchar) tb_amount / pg_amount (bigint) difference (bigint) currency (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) status (varchar: open/investigating/resolved) resolved_by / resolved_at resolution_notes (text) created_at
TigerBeetle is source of truth for balances. PostgreSQL stores transaction metadata. This service reconciles TB ledger entries against PG transaction records daily.
